title: In JetBrains Toolbox App before 3.6.1 nTLM hash disclosure was possible via SVG tool icons from a Remote Development…
description: JetBrains Toolbox App versions before 3.6.1 contain a vulnerability that allows NTLM hash disclosure via SVG tool icons loaded from a Remote Development server. This issue could expose sensitive authentication hashes to remote attackers. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
